text:
The equation Δp = ρgΔh can be used for a liquid.
8
What is the meaning of the term ρ?
A
pressure due to the liquid
B
density of the liquid
C
total pressure due to the liquid and the air above the liquid
D
density of an object placed in the liquid

options.label: C
options.text: total pressure due to the liquid and the air above the liquid

options.label: D
options.text: density of an object placed in the liquid
